name: Dr Rajeev Reddy
verified_role: Consultant Orthopaedic Oncosurgeon (Orthopaedic Oncology / Sarcoma), Apollo Cancer Institute - Apollo Hospitals, Jubilee Hills (Apollo Health City), Hyderabad; Founder of Osteon Orthopedic Clinic, Hitech City, Hyderabad
verified_experience: 18+ years (per Apollo247 official profile; other sources list 17-19 years)
hni_signals: Consultant Orthopaedic Oncosurgeon and sarcoma / musculoskeletal-oncology specialist at Apollo Cancer Institute, Apollo Hospitals, Jubilee Hills (Apollo Health City), Hyderabad. Founder/owner of Osteon Orthopedic Clinic, Silicon Valley, Image Gardens Lane, Hitech City, Hyderabad (own practice - strong ownership signal). Also practices at Udai Omni Hospital, Nampally, Hyderabad and is a visiting consultant at Apollo Cancer Hospitals in Visakhapatnam and Bhubaneswar. Medical Registration No. 83922. Qualifications MBBS and D.Ortho (Kasturba Medical College, Manipal University), DNB Orthopaedics, Fellowship in Orthopaedic Oncology & Limb Salvage (Hinduja Hospital, Mumbai), with foreign training at the Royal Orthopaedic Hospital, Birmingham (UK) and the Rizzoli Orthopaedic Institute, Bologna (Italy). ~22 publications in international journals. Awards include the APJ Abdul Kalam Health & Medical Excellence Award, Fellow of IGOF (Germany) and a Gold Medal in MS Orthopaedics; Life Member of the British Orthopaedic Oncology Society and member of the Australia & New Zealand Sarcoma Association and the Indian Musculoskeletal Oncology Society. Maintains his own professional website (orthoonco.com).
